title: lasthenia glabrata var. californica
intro: Lasthenia glabrata var. californica, commonly known as California goldfields, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is a perennial herb that grows in the wild, particularly in the western United States. California goldfields have been traditionally used for their medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory properties.
